2607.25814.title: Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in Arabic Language Models
2607.25814.paper_summary: The emergence of the recent outstanding capabilities of Arabic Language Models has opened doors for exposing their vulnerabilities. One of the major security risks associated with such Natural Language Processing models is adversarial attacks. These attacks can deceive the model into the wrong prediction, raising critical model security and safety concerns. This study aims to assess the robustness of five state-of-the-art Arabic Language Models under a distinct set of Arabic adversarial attacks applied at various levels of granularity and using different example generation strategies. We also explore a defense technique based on adversarial training to enhance model robustness. The results show that insertion of diacritics can reduce the accuracy of some models by 92% while maintaining a low perturbation distance. For word-level attacks, manipulating Arabic conjunctions preserves high semantic similarity scores, low perturbation distance, and leads to an accuracy degradation of up to 58%. For sentence-level attacks, paraphrasing proves its effectiveness by an average reduction of 76% in the victim models' performance. While adversarial training improves overall resilience, with MARBERT being the most robust and AraBERT showing the greatest relative gains, challenges persist, particularly against character-level noise. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of current defense strategies in morphologically rich languages like Arabic.
2607.25814.paper_summary_zh: 阿拉伯語模型最近出現的卓越能力為揭示其脆弱性開啟了大門。與這類自然語言處理模型相關的主要安全風險之一是對抗攻擊。這些攻擊可以欺騙模型做出錯誤預測，從而引發關鍵的模型安全和安全性問題。本研究旨在評估五種最先進的阿拉伯語模型在一組獨特的阿拉伯對抗攻擊下的穩健性，這些攻擊在不同的粒度層次上應用，並使用不同的示例生成策略。我們還探討了一種基於對抗訓練的防禦技術，以增強模型的穩健性。結果顯示，插入變音符號可以使某些模型的準確率降低92%，同時保持低擾動距離。對於單詞級攻擊，操縱阿拉伯語連接詞能保持高語義相似度分數、低擾動距離，並導致準確率下降高達58%。對於句子級攻擊，改寫證明其有效性，受害模型的性能平均降低76%。雖然對抗訓練提高了整體韌性，其中MARBERT是最穩健的，而AraBERT顯示出最大的相對增益，但挑戰仍然存在，特別是針對字符級噪聲。這些發現突顯了當前防禦策略在像阿拉伯語這樣形態豐富的語言中的潛力和局限性。
